kind: Actual React provider + WorkspaceCard + recovered Impact controls mounted in jsdom

checks.name: Actual WorkspaceCards register stable semantic IDs and readable titles
Loading affects one report, retains the original mounted body footprint, hides it semantically, and preserves scope and selected rows
Real Impact Retry button restores only the failed card; unrelated failure, child identity, selection, sort and hidden columns survive
Retained failure keeps current evidence readable with its exact source refresh timestamp and explicit local-rehearsal disclosure
Legitimate missing-feed and empty-result states remain distinct and do not acquire misleading retry actions
New scope clears component rehearsals without remounting the table or flashing an unrelated category; returning Back does not reactivate a stale failure
Retry is limited to actual failure states; Ready rehearsal restores a loading card without invoking any workspace reset
A removed report deregisters from the live target list without remounting neighboring content; workspace cleanup succeeds

limitations: Not a Chrome or pixel-layout assertion; root owns native walkthrough.
The local synchronous dataset has explicit rehearsal controls, not production network requests.
A production request adapter, response cache and service retry policy remain external integrations.
